% Build helper and usage example: compile with `pdflatex Build.tex`.
% Demonstrates figure inclusion via MetaVect.tex and source highlighting via
% the metavect listings language. Replace `example-figure.pdf` with real
% backend output; the placeholder rule below keeps the example compilable.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{listings}
\usepackage{metavect}
% Loaded after the package: \providecommand definitions below are no-ops
% for macros the package already provides, so there is no redefinition.
\input{MetaVect.tex}
\begin{document}
\section*{MetaVect \MetaVectVersion\ example}

\begin{metavectcode}
-- First milestone: parse only; none of these expressions are evaluated.
module examples.first
import prelude

export identity : Int -> Int = fn(value: Int) => value
export size : Int = let base : Int = 20 in
    if base > 0 then identity(base + 2 * 3) else 0
\end{metavectcode}

Figure inclusion (expects a backend-rendered file):
\begin{center}
  \IfFileExists{example-figure.pdf}{\MetaVectGraphic{example-figure.pdf}}{%
    \fbox{\parbox{0.7\linewidth}{\centering Placeholder for MetaVect backend output}}}
\end{center}
\end{document}
